description: Right-to-left documents (pdfnative 1.9.0 through pdfnative-mcp 1.8.0): direction:'auto' reads each paragraph's first strong character, so the Arabic paragraphs are laid out right-to-left and right-aligned while the Latin one stays left-to-right; the untagged output carries an /ActualText span per right-to-left run (layout.actualText, default true), so extract_text returns the logical string. A paragraph's own direction overrides the document setting. The second step reads the text back in reading order.

arguments.title: Bidirectional notice
paragraphs: تُصدر هذه الوثيقة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية، ويُعتمد النص العربي عند الاختلاف.
This notice is issued in Arabic and English; the Arabic text prevails in case of discrepancy.
رقم المرجع: PDF-2026-001 — صالح حتى 31 ديسمبر 2026.
